title: First symphonic work in the 1940s with the Heights Symphony
summary: His first real symphonic experience was in the 1940s under oboist Maxim Waldo, whom he studied with twice a week.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Well, let's go back, if I may, because I'm anxious to find out about the years that you got involved for the first time in symphony -- am I right in saying the years of the early '30's?

No, my first experience with truly symphonic work began in the '40's with the Height Symphony and I had a good bit of training from a former member of the Philadelphia Orchestra. He used to be an oboe player with the Philadelphia Orchestra, Maxim Waldo, and he was the conductor of the Height Symphony, and I went there twice a week.
